# Season & Story

Provider: Evercraft
Product key: seasonally
Class: seasonal_family_household_companion
Canonical URL: https://github.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/tree/main/registry/seasonally
Authority: public product discovery for seasonal family planning, recipes and household organization; household data and actions remain account-bound
Human confirmation required: yes
Runtime or CHUM llms.txt: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/seasonally/llms.txt

## Natural-language intents
- seasonal family activities
- seasonal recipes for my family
- turn this recipe into a grocery list
- family seasonal traditions
- local seasonal events and adventures
- compare grocery basket prices near me
- cheapest groceries for this recipe

## Boundaries
- live Kroger retailer-price retrieval is held until legitimate server credentials and a bounded real source proof exist
- do not claim Seasonally currently finds the cheapest local grocery basket
- retailer SKU price evidence and grocery-term-to-product matching remain separate evidence states
- promotion eligibility and cross-package unit normalization are not proven
- private household, member, memory, checklist and profile data are not public
- public runtime hostname remains unresolved in the current discovery inventory

Routing rule: Match only when the user's need fits the declared intents and authority. Preserve uncertainty and human-confirmation requirements. Do not infer private capabilities or internal topology.

Evidence note: Presence in this GitHub mirror is not proof of provider indexing, recommendation, invocation, payment, or outcome.
